label: Nice dance — attractive motion with possible compromises
commentary: The buyer called this Kashi video a nice table dance with pleasing bright/dark contrast (#22), while noting possible too-dark central steps, small windmills, a large reported table and crown questions. Ibrakeforpossums cautiously liked the stone provided that transparency or windowing was not a problem (#23). This is a source-qualified positive/mixed example, not an unconditional endorsement. The original MP4 exists in the #64 research archive but is not yet registered as playable Learning Corner evidence.
